text:
Marie: Starting a canary ramp to 15% for release v2.4.1 across regions at 21:00 UTC. Change window 21:00-22:30. Deploy kicked off: /deploy release=v2.4.1 percent=5->15 queue=auto

deploy-bot: [21:00:01] Deploy started: v2.4.1 -> canary 5% (all regions). CI: green. Link: https://deploy.internal/r/3287654321

Vijay: Noted. watching infra metrics.

Laura: I saw a small p95 blip in staging earlier. Will keep an eye on canary.

Tom: infra alert — EU k8s nodes showing CPU burst ~2m ago. CPU avg 78% -> 92% on sidecars. digging.

Kevin: Can you post the grafana panel? Need numbers before we decide to pause.

Tom: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/canary-overview?orgId=1 panel: p95 latency eu = 243ms (baseline 120ms), errors 0.8% (baseline 0.1%) :thinking_face: 

deploy-bot: [21:04:12] Canary at 10% -> rolling to 15% (scheduled); safety checks: KV cache backpressure = false, OOM risk = low

Marie: @sre-oncall / @Vijay if p95 >200ms or errors >0.5% in EU we hold at 15% and pin region to v2.4.0. Decision?

sre-oncall: Agree hold. Initiate draincheck and pin for EU. I'll run canary-drain script.

Vijay: +1. Will open an incident ticket and notify CS (release notes update).

Laura: QA: validating top prompt sets — if we pin, please flip traffic routing to secondary model variant in EU to avoid cache warmup penalty.

Tom: Running drain check now: `./scripts/draincheck --region=eu --timeout=120`

Tom: draincheck log: "connections draining" then "cache-clobber risk detected" — recommending pause and rollback EU to v2.4.0

deploy-bot: [21:09:55] Action required: Pause traffic increase. Current canary: 15% global; EU segment 6.2%. Pause schedule aborted.

Marie: Okay, pausing ramp. @deploy-bot pin-region eu->v2.4.0 and stop further percentage increases.

deploy-bot: [21:10:02] Pin applied: EU pinned to v2.4.0. Global canary remains at 15% with EU excluded. Rollback not triggered (manual pin).

Kevin: Filing ticket: INC-3287 "EU canary latency spike — pin to v2.4.0, investigate cache-clobber". Adding logs and grafana links.

Vijay: Notifying customer-facing channels and CS. Will append to release notes: "15% canary paused in EU due to latency; rollback pin applied; investigation ongoing."

Laura: Tests: QA will run a focused regression suite against v2.4.1 in eu-like env and validate cache interactions. ETA 45m.

sre-oncall: For follow-up: check kernel driver versions on EU nodes and recent infra deploys. I'll coordinate with infra team.

Marie: Thanks all. Next steps: wait for QA signoff or infra mitigation before resuming ramp. If no fix in 60m, we will schedule staged rollback for EU at 22:15 UTC unless new info.

Tom: ack. Posting more logs as I get them.

Vijay: Will update ticket and reopen thread if rollforward approved.

deploy-bot: [21:12:30] Note: release notes auto-draft created at https://docs.internal/releases/v2.4.1-draft
